decision.observation: Attack on the shell base lever had no effect - the shell and its bronze fittings are static background decoration. The stone path continues left off-screen at ~(0.15, 0.75), and there are flat-capped black mushrooms low to the ground on the left at ~(0.10, 0.79) and ~(0.20, 0.75).
decision.hypothesis: The shell is confirmed non-interactive. Flat-capped mushrooms may be bouncy surfaces (as in some H-K style levels) that launch the player upward - worth standing on one. First head left along the stone path to reach the mushroom cluster.
decision.memory: Shell + bronze lever = pure decoration, all interactions fail. Tall/flat black mushrooms untested as jump platforms or bounce surfaces.
